teacher_events.normal_load_basis: mg/(2*mu)*safety/finger_kp; no wider than previous command

teacher_events.compression_semantics: Joint target difference, not measured material penetration; first-contact command may predate measured finger response

original_grasp_relative_pose.position_reference: Vessel bottom-frame origin in hand frame; includes rotation lever-arm motion, not isolated axial slip.
original_grasp_relative_pose.anchor_reference: Configured body point[0,0,grasp_height] in hand frame, not measured contact pressure centre. Anchor metrics are analysis only; existing acceptance gates unchanged.

static_grasp.boundary_definition: Independent observed physical lift/source-clear/near-target events; teacher phase ignored

extraction.boundary_definition: Independent observed physical lift/source-clear/near-target events; teacher phase ignored

transport.boundary_definition: Independent observed physical lift/source-clear/near-target events; teacher phase ignored

limitations: Same fixed scene, nominal grasp point, retimed duration and force upper bound; only GRASP post-latch orientation feedback intentionally suppressed. Exact source/config comparison remains separately verifiable, no statistical claim from1pair.
Bottom-frame position drift includes rotation lever; anchor metric analysis does not replace original acceptance.
Original final false/GRASP_SLIP preserved; completed loading/retreat motions and stable final state are not scorer success.
No calibration or hardware precision inference; no privileged diagnostic coordinates written to policy.
